name: Grandvrio Ocean Resort Danang
detail: During my recent trip to Da Nang, what stayed with me the most at the hotel was the warmth and attentiveness of the staff, beyond the hotel facilities. My room was on the top floor of the hotel building and was very spacious with high ceilings, and the cleaning was thorough. The location facing the sea offered a pleasant view from the room, allowing me to feel like I was in a resort from the moment I woke up. Personally, I really liked the hot spring. There was a large public bath, sauna, and cold-water bath, with shampoo, conditioner, and body soap provided. Moreover, bath towels were also available, making it very convenient to go without bringing anything from the room. It was open from 6 am to 11 pm, so I could enjoy the hot spring after returning from sightseeing and go again the following morning... which was very nice. The fitness center had treadmills, cycles, benches, and was sufficient for me to get a little exercise while traveling. I was also happy that towels were provided. Outdoors, there was space for basketball and badminton. The proximity of the beach right in front of the hotel was also attractive. Compared to My Khe Beach, the ocean seemed clearer. However, since the water is not shallow, I think it's better to be cautious when entering the sea with small children. Above all, what left a strong impression were the staff. There was a Japanese manager, who was not only there during check-in and check-out. They would talk to us during breakfast every morning and promptly answered any questions or concerns we had for the day. I believe this attitude has been passed on to the rest of the staff. Everyone was very calm and consistently attentive, ensuring that guests felt comfortable throughout their stay. They remembered names, room numbers, and would often rush ahead to call the elevator for you. When I was waiting for a Grab in the lobby, they proactively checked if I was waiting for a vehicle even before I asked. All of these may seem like small gestures, but they accumulated throughout my stay, making me feel valued in this hotel. On the final day, I had a late-night flight, so after returning to the hotel in the evening, I took one last dip in the hot spring, packed my bags, and enjoyed a leisurely time until departure. I think this hotel is more about enjoying the time spent at the hotel rather than just a place to stay while sightseeing. There are many hotels with excellent facilities, but not many make you feel I want to stay again as much as this one, thanks to the approach of the staff. During this stay, I felt that the hospitality that Gran Ville Resort Da Nang values was clearly communicated to the guests. If I have friends going to Da Nang, I would definitely recommend this hotel. And I personally would like to stay here again the next time I visit Da Nang. Thank you to the staff for a wonderful stay.

name: Radisson Hotel Danang
detail: Cost performance, location, cleanliness It was very good. The sunrise view from the hotel was the best. The customer service was very kind, and they attended to me without any tension, despite my complete lack of English. The room was very clean. However, because it is in front of the beach, music from the beach echoes into the room until late at night. I do not recommend it for those who are sensitive to noise. We are a couple in our 50s, and while it bothered us on the first day, we were fine from the second day on. Just for reference.

name: New Orient Hotel Da Nang
detail: 🇻🇳 Review of New Orient Hotel in Da Nang 🏨✨ For this trip to Da Nang, I chose the New Orient Hotel as my accommodation! First of all, the hotel itself is clean and has a beautiful atmosphere, which made me feel good as soon as I walked in🤍 The room was larger and cleaner than I expected, and the bedding was comfortable, making it great for resting during my travels. What I liked the most was the swimming pool! 🏊🏻‍♀️ The atmosphere of the pool was lovely, and it was a nice place to relax while enjoying the water, making it enjoyable to spend leisurely time at the hotel. The breakfast also had quite a variety, ranging from Vietnamese cuisine to simple menu options, so I could have a hearty meal every morning before heading out🥐🍜 The location is also decent! It was easy to get to Han Market or downtown, and it was a convenient spot for taking Grab rides, making it great for moving around while sightseeing. Additionally, the staff were really friendly, which contributed to a pleasant experience from check-in throughout my stay☺️ Overall, I was satisfied with the room condition, pool, breakfast, and service considering the price! If you're looking for a clean and pretty hotel in Da Nang that isn't too expensive, this is definitely a place worth considering💛

name: Sea Near Me Hotel Danang
detail: The location is very favorable, the hotel is about a 5-minute walk to the beach, so you can comfortably swim and relax on the beach in the afternoon while reading a book. The staff is extremely friendly and cheerful. The room is large, clean, and the bed is very soft and comfortable.

name: Crystal Hotel
detail: The room I stayed in had a view of Yong Bridge. The room and bedding were clean, the water pressure was good, and hot water came out well. The rooftop pool view is also nice. It is close to the beach as well. The staff were friendly, and it seems to be a good value for money. ^^

name: Golden Lotus Grand Da Nang
detail: An absolute 10/10 experience, Golden Lotus Grand Da Nang exceeds every expectation with its unbeatable location just a short stroll from My Khe Beach, luxurious and spotlessly clean rooms featuring private balconies, and breathtaking rooftop infinity pool views. From the rich breakfast buffet showcasing authentic Vietnamese specialties to the charming daily afternoon tea and genuinely warm, attentive staff who make you feel at home from start to finish, every single detail creates an unforgettable, five-star stay that I cannot recommend highly enough!

name: Royal Beach Hotel
detail: This is an honest review. Looking at the pictures, the furniture is beautiful. The actual review is that there are pros and cons. The room is very spacious and I got it for just over 500, which is a great deal. However, the hotel is old; there are two elevators that are slow, and the hallway has a musty smell due to the old condition of the hotel. The bedroom and bathroom are very large but also have a musty smell. The refrigerator in the room cools well but is not very clean. Overall, I would give it a 6/10. I would still like to stay again, but I might try another place. Check-in is at 1:00 PM. The comfort of the bed deserves a 10/10; it’s incredibly comfortable. The bathroom is very large and clean, but there’s a musty smell throughout the room, and there’s black mold on the grout. The air conditioning is very cold, but the room is not soundproof; you can hear people walking around or vendors outside.

name: Sea Front Hotel
detail: The service is pleasant and the hotel offers great value for money. The building shows some age, but the linens and bathrooms were clean and comfortable. The access to the beach and airport is good, and the location is excellent. The breakfast had a modest variety but was delicious. There are some issues with noise from surrounding voices and outside sounds at night (having earplugs can provide peace of mind), but considering the price, it was an overall highly satisfying stay.

name: Fivitel Da Nang Hotel
detail: The location is under the Yong Bridge, and it's quiet and nice. It's about a 15-minute commute to Hanjisang, My Khe Beach, and Lotte Mart, making it convenient to get around. Overall, it has a 4-star quality, and the staff are friendly. The management of the beds and rooms is decent, and the breakfast, while not lavish or varied, is sufficient. The rooftop pool view and the night view from the room are absolutely fantastic. I am confident that you will be satisfied with this level of hotel quality in the price range of 40,000 to 50,000 won.
